title: Functions
preview: Identify functions, read and build function tables, construct and compare linear functions, and analyze nonlinear and qualitative graphs.
description: Students develop the definition of a function, work with function tables, construct linear functions from context, compare functions across representations, and distinguish linear from nonlinear behavior including qualitative graph analysis.

sections.label: 4-1 Identify Functions
sections.description: One output per input. Recognise functions across tables, graphs, and mappings.

sections.label: 4-2 Function Tables
sections.description: Read a function table, infer the rule, and predict outputs.

warmupRefs.title: Find the rule, fill the table

sections.label: 4-3 Construct Linear Functions
sections.description: Build a linear function from a real context and use it to model and predict.

sections.label: 4-4 Compare Functions
sections.description: Translate among equations, tables, and graphs to compare rates of change.

sections.label: 4-5 Nonlinear Functions
sections.description: Test for linearity in tables and equations; classify common nonlinear shapes.

sections.label: 4-6 Qualitative Graphs
sections.description: Describe the story a graph tells: increasing, decreasing, constant, and where the rate changes.

source.name: Plug N Play
source.attribution: Plug N Play. Module organisation aligned to Indiana grade-8 academic standards (functions, 8.AF.3 / 8.AF.5 / 8.AF.6 / 8.AF.7).
